text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, I come across Symboli<n>Rudolf in the
cafeteria, sitting in front<n>of a veritable buffet of
dishes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. What an unexpected<n>pleasure.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Quite the sight, isn't it? These are<n>new dishes that
the chef has...<n>cooked up, if you'll excuse the pun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The academy staff are constantly<n>searching for
new ways to make<n>campus life more enjoyable
for the<n>students.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That includes revising the cafeteria<n>menu from
time to time. It's hard to<n>overstate the debt we
owe them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Seeing as we share a common goal, I<n>thought the
least I could do is lend a<n>hand...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I have offered to serve<n>as a
taste-tester.
choice_data_list: Don't you think this is a bit much?
Don't you think this is a bit much?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I have offered to serve<n>as a
taste-tester.
choice_data_list: Don't you think this is a bit much?
Don't you think this is a bit much?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I appreciate the chef's<n>enthusiasm, but I
can't possibly<n>finish all this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Still, now that I have offered my<n>assistance, I have
to make good on<n>my word. What to do...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But of course. How silly of me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I wanted to find somebody who<n>cares deeply for
Umamusume, I<n>didn't have to look far, did I?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: By all means, I would welcome your<n>assistance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
With our combined efforts, we can<n>make this
cafeteria the best it can be!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf and I spend the rest of<n>the day
sampling a variety of dishes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Quite. There are a formidable number<n>of dishes to
get through, and they all<n>seem awfully filling...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But if this will help create a menu that<n>can satisfy
the students' appetites,<n>I'll do all I can.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
First up, we have... the Deluxe Shrimp<n>Alfredo
Pasta Bowl!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the academy's<n>hungry students,
Symboli Rudolf<n>pushes her stomach to the limit.
